svg.title: Who leads each workload
svg.desc: Small-multiple line charts of the leading model's share of each OpenRouter workload over time, with lab-coloured markers and workload token share on a second axis.
svg.text: Who leads each workload — and how often the answer changes
Each line is a workload's leading-model share over 9 weekly captures, grouped by macro category
Marker fill = that week's leading lab. The thin, faint line is the workload's share of all tokens on a second axis.
29 of 29 workloads changed leader at least once; the top three per category are shown.
Every line is a leading model's share OF ITS OWN WORKLOAD, not a share of the whole market. A flat, high line is a defended niche; a low, jumpy line is contested.
The thin line lets a shrinking workload keep a high leader share. Marker colours are a lab, not a model: two DeepSeek snapshots are both blue.
Source: OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/rankings), as of 2026-10-19. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
